notes.title: Fist quick fixes
notes.content:
Hey, we're so happy to see that players are having fun and that the game has been relatively stable. 

We Found some smaller issues that have been fixed:

- Space for slow-motion is removed. 
- Fixed bug where the player could float
- Updated start tutorial
- Fixed a poopstain issue. 

we'll post again soon with some additional Fixes. 

Thanks for playing, 

[b]HAVE FUN! [/b]
